name: Captain Advance Filter
author: Devang Vachheta

sections.description:
Captain Advance Filter is a lightweight WordPress search and filter plugin that lets you create powerful AJAX powered filters for posts, pages, custom post types, and WooCommerce products.

Create advanced search and filtering experiences without coding. Build custom queries and filter sets, choose from multiple filter types and display styles, and show filtered results instantly without reloading the page.

Filter your content by categories, tags, custom taxonomies, post meta, product attributes, price, stock status, ratings, dates, and more. Display filter options using checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, search fields, range sliders, A Z navigation, date pickers, WooCommerce ratings, or a frontend view switcher.

Use the visual Query Builder and Filter Set Builder to create reusable filtering systems, then display them anywhere using shortcodes, Gutenberg blocks, or Elementor widgets.

✨ Core Features:

  • AJAX Search & Filtering: Update results instantly without a page reload.
  • Visual Query Builder: Create custom queries for posts, pages, custom post types, and products.
  • Filter Set Builder: Combine multiple filters and connect them to a reusable query.
  • Multiple Filter Types: Checkbox, Radio, Dropdown, Search, Range, A Z, Date Picker, Woo Rating, and View Switcher.
  • Taxonomy & Meta Filtering: Filter content using categories, tags, custom taxonomies, custom fields, and post meta.
  • WooCommerce Product Filters: Filter products by attributes, price, stock status, and star ratings.
  • Multiple Display Styles: List, Buttons, Color Swatches, Image Swatches, and Tabs for supported filters.
  • AJAX Pagination: Choose from numbered Pagination, Load More, Infinite Scroll, or None.
  • AJAX Loader Styles: Choose Spinner, Overlay, Skeleton, or None for AJAX result loading.
  • Frontend View Switcher: Let visitors switch between available grid column layouts.
  • Shareable Filter URLs: Share and bookmark filtered results with selected filter values preserved in the URL.
  • Result Count: Display the number of matching results with a dedicated shortcode.
  • Custom Result Cards: Choose from predefined card styles or create custom card templates.
  • Responsive Grid Layouts: Control desktop, tablet, and mobile columns.
  • Elementor Support: Dedicated Filter, Grid, and Pagination widgets.
  • Gutenberg Support: Native blocks for Filter, Grid, and Pagination.
  • Shortcode Support: Easily embed filters, grids, pagination, and result counts anywhere.
  • Query Caching: Optional caching using WordPress transients for faster repeated queries.
  • Dark Mode: Clean and modern React powered admin dashboard with Dark Mode support.
  • No Coding Required: Build queries and filters directly from the WordPress admin dashboard.

🔎 Filter Types:

  • Checkbox: Select one or multiple options.
  • Radio: Select a single option.
  • Dropdown: Choose filter values from a dropdown.
  • Search: Search and filter content using keywords.
  • Range: Create numeric range filters such as price ranges.
  • A Z: Browse content alphabetically.
  • Date Picker: Filter content by publish date ranges.
  • Woo Rating: Filter WooCommerce products by star rating.
  • View Switcher: Allow visitors to switch between available result grid layouts.

🎨 Display Styles:

Checkbox and Radio filters can use multiple display styles depending on the selected data source:

  • List
  • Buttons
  • Color Swatches
  • Image Swatches
  • Tabs

Color and Image Swatches can automatically use WooCommerce attribute swatch data when available, with fallback options when swatch data is not configured.

📄 Pagination & Loading:

Choose how filtered results are displayed and loaded:

  • Pagination: Standard numbered pagination.
  • Load More: Load additional results without leaving the page.
  • Infinite Scroll: Automatically load more results while scrolling.
  • None: Display results without pagination controls.

Choose an AJAX loading indicator for each query:

  • Spinner
  • Overlay
  • Skeleton
  • None

🛒 WooCommerce Compatibility:

Captain Advance Filter works with WooCommerce and provides dedicated product filtering features.

  • Woo Rating: Filter products by N stars & up using WooCommerce product ratings.
  • Price Range: Filter products using WooCommerce price data.
  • Stock Status: Filter products by available stock status.
  • Product Attributes: Filter by attributes such as color, brand, size, and more.
  • Color Swatches: Display product attribute options as color swatches.
  • Image Swatches: Display product attribute options using images.
  • Shop Card: Display WooCommerce product price, sale badge, and Add to Cart button.
  • Custom Product Templates: Use WooCommerce specific tokens such as {{price}}, {{sale_badge}}, and {{add_to_cart}}.

🧩 Custom Post Type Support:

Use Captain Advance Filter with any publicly viewable WordPress post type. Create custom queries and filter results using taxonomies, post meta, dates, search terms, and other supported filter sources.

🔌 Builder Integrations:

  • Elementor: Dedicated Filter, Grid, and Pagination widgets with Elementor styling controls.
  • Gutenberg: Native blocks for Filter, Grid, and Pagination.
  • Shortcodes: Use Captain Advance Filter with any WordPress page builder or theme that supports shortcodes.
  • Bricks Builder: Support coming soon.

⚡ Performance:

  • Lightweight frontend implementation.
  • AJAX powered filtering without full page reloads.
  • Frontend assets are loaded only on pages where Captain Advance Filter is used.
  • No jQuery dependency on the frontend.
  • Optional query result caching using WordPress transients.
  • Native lazy loading support for result card images.

🔗 Shortcodes:

  • [captaf-filter id="1"] : Display a filter set.
  • [captaf-grid query="query_key"] : Display the filtered content grid.
  • [captaf-pagination query="query_key"] : Display pagination controls.
  • [captaf-count query="query_key"] : Display the matching result count.

You can also display individual filters from a Filter Set using the only attribute.

🌟 OUR PRODUCTS:

🥇 Captain Feed for YouTube : Display YouTube videos, channels, playlists, and live streams on your WordPress website with flexible layouts and customization options.

🥇 Captain Social Review : Display reviews and testimonials from multiple platforms with beautiful layouts, filtering options, and easy customization.

🥇 Captain Widgets Kit : Extend your WordPress website with a collection of powerful widgets and elements designed to enhance your website building experience.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Captain Advance Filter from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create a Query using the Query Builder.
  5. Create a Filter Set and connect it to your Query.
  6. Configure your filter types, display styles, pagination, and loader settings.
  7. Add the generated shortcode to your page or use the Elementor or Gutenberg integration.
sections.faq:
Does Captain Advance Filter work without Elementor?

Yes. Elementor is optional. You can use Captain Advance Filter with Gutenberg blocks, shortcodes, or any WordPress theme that supports shortcodes.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Captain Advance Filter supports WooCommerce product filtering by attributes, price, stock status, and product ratings. WooCommerce specific Shop Card and swatch options are also available.

Can I filter custom post types?

Yes. Any publicly viewable WordPress post type can be used as a Query source.

Can I filter by custom fields or post meta?

Yes. Filters can use supported post meta fields as a data source in addition to taxonomies.

Does it support AJAX filtering?

Yes. Filtered results are loaded using AJAX without requiring a full page reload.

What pagination options are available?

You can choose between numbered Pagination, Load More, Infinite Scroll, or None.

What loader styles are available?

You can choose Spinner, Overlay, Skeleton, or None for AJAX result loading.

Can visitors switch between grid layouts?

Yes. Add the View Switcher filter type to allow visitors to switch between the available frontend grid column layouts.

Can I create shareable filtered URLs?

Yes. Enable the Shareable URL option for supported filters to sync selected filter values with the page URL. Visitors can share or bookmark filtered results.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Queries and Filter Sets can be created using the visual admin dashboard. Shortcodes are generated automatically.

Will Captain Advance Filter slow down my website?

The plugin uses conditional asset loading so frontend assets are only loaded on pages where Captain Advance Filter is actually used. Optional query caching is also available to improve repeated searches.

Are the frontend REST endpoints secure?

Yes. The filtering endpoints verify that queried post types and taxonomies are publicly viewable before returning results. Private data is not exposed through these endpoints.
